extracted.name: Cream Cheese Pickles
extracted.description: Like the best part of a sandwich...without the bread! Cream cheese pairs up with sour dills and thin-sliced deli beef.
instruction_lines: Spread or pat cream cheese onto each slice of meat.
Wrap 2 sheets of meat around each pickle.
Refrigerate pickles overnight, and slice before serving.
